## Result algebra

A result makes a claim about one predicate on one subject and basis. Its core
record contains the predicate, exact subject and basis, verdict, performance,
original qualified domain outcome, supporting evidence and citations, unresolved
obligations and material effect observations. A reference can carry these when
its resolution preserves their meaning and availability. This is a semantic
contract, not a mandatory serialization format or additional work carrier.

F1 selects the question and F2/F6 restrict its answer to supported evidence.
Because an execution can be interrupted and its effects can outlive its actor
(F3/F5), evaluation performance, the predicate's truth and effect completion
are separate questions. The informational contribution is the recoverable
meaning of each answer; the computational contribution is what was performed
and observed. The following value choices implement those distinctions.
RF-012 and every domain refinement bind all three questions before consuming a
label such as `ready` or `refused`; no label decides the other predicates.

The verdict has exactly these values:

| Value | Meaning for the bound predicate |
|---|---|
| `satisfied` | Admissible evidence establishes the predicate under its declared evaluation rule. |
| `falsified` | Admissible evidence establishes a counterexample or failure of that predicate. |
| `indeterminate` | The available admissible evidence does not decide the predicate. |
| `out_of_frame` | The predicate is outside the evaluation's bound scope or capability; it is not silently omitted from the wider obligation. |
| `invalid_basis` | The subject, governing basis or required interpretation is invalid for the claimed evaluation. |

Performance records whether the named predicate's declared evaluation was
actually undertaken; it is `performed`, `not_performed` or `unconfirmed`.
The activation identifies that evaluation separately from dispatch, admission
or the work being assessed. Retain the observed extent, interruption and
conclusion in its outcome and evidence. The legal pairs are:

| Performance | Permitted verdicts | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `performed` | Any of the five verdicts | Evidence establishes that the evaluation was undertaken, including a scoped basis or capability diagnosis. Its extent and conclusion remain separate facts. |
| `not_performed` | Any except `satisfied`, with the evidence condition below | Evidence establishes that the evaluation was not undertaken. Dispatch or admission alone does not establish performance. |
| `unconfirmed` | Any except `satisfied`, with the evidence condition below | Whether the evaluation was undertaken is not established. |

An interruption does not erase evaluation already undertaken or admissible
evidence obtained. A suite aborted after a witnessed failure is performed with
that partial extent and falsifies “all tests pass”. A completed load test that
cannot generate its required load is performed but indeterminate on the
requested service-performance predicate. Neither case is a never-run test.
Satisfaction still requires all evidence and completion conditions selected by
the predicate's evaluation rule; performed alone proves none of them.

When the selected evaluation was not undertaken or its performance is
unconfirmed, separately admissible counterevidence to its bound predicate can
still establish falsified; an established basis or scope diagnosis can likewise
establish invalid_basis or out_of_frame. The result identifies that independent
support without inventing execution. Without deciding support it is
indeterminate. An absent return establishes neither non-performance nor an
undecidable evaluation: retain the missing slot and what is actually known.

A missing required judgment stays an absent coverage slot, with the known
performance fact or its uncertainty; it is not a fabricated child result. A
performed but undecidable evaluation differs from a known unperformed one and
from unconfirmed execution. A failed admission check can conclude while
downstream work does not. The plan fixes which predicates are required; a
precondition is evidence for its dependent evaluation unless the plan separately
requires that precondition as a predicate. A concluding basis/scope diagnosis
on P reports invalid_basis/out_of_frame on P with its supporting evidence; a
different admission predicate is not silently substituted for P. An aborted
procedure does not erase separately authenticated counterexamples observed
during the attempt. Every result projection preserves these
coordinates and the original predicate; a verdict alone is an insufficient
handoff where performance is material.

An effect observation is `not_requested`, `not_started`, `completed`, `partial`,
`reverted` or `unknown`, on its declared observation boundary. These values describe the selected effect and observation
boundary, not the predicate verdict. `not_started` needs evidence that the selected effect did not begin, including
an authenticated rejection before mutation. Transport dispatch alone proves
neither effect completion nor absence; `unknown` includes a lost acknowledgment
after possible execution.
`reverted` means that at least one part began and every begun part is observed to have been reversed within
the declared boundary, with the reversal and any unstarted remainder retained
as evidence. For every effect value, the boundary includes each material part
the operation may have affected under its supported operating model and any
observed departure, whether requested or unintended. Irreversible messages or
other material external effects cannot be omitted to improve a result.
`partial` means an observed
completed part and an observed requested but unexecuted, or reverted, remainder.
If any material remainder has unknown completion, the state is `unknown`,
retaining the completed parts as evidence. An effect can be completed while
the intended product outcome is falsified.
An empty local log or discarded context does not establish no effect.
`not_requested` states an established effect-free scope under that operating
model; lack of a request alone is insufficient. A material possible unintended
effect without sufficient observation is `unknown`. If observation establishes
that an unrequested possible part did not begin, it contributes `not_requested`
at this boundary, retaining that observation and any earlier uncertainty.
It is not an uncompleted requested remainder. A requested part observed not to
begin remains `not_started`.

A refined value is the pair of original domain outcome and cause in its
declared reason domain, including an explicit missing-reason case. A domain
refinement preserves that qualified original outcome and supplies a
total, reason-sensitive map into this record. If the original outcome is too
coarse to determine a verdict, its required reason distinguishes the cases; a
consumer cannot guess from a word such as `refused`, `ready` or `accepted`.
A missing required reason maps the claimed predicate to indeterminate and
leaves that contribution inadmissible as deciding support for its slot;
retain its raw outcome and unresolved authentication. Its claimed predicate
remains indeterminate until admissible evidence decides it. Independently
established counterevidence or a basis/scope diagnosis uses the legal pairs above
on that same bound predicate; it does not invent execution or completion.
Requested or material possible unintended effects without sufficient observation
are unknown, never defaulted to not_requested. Unconfirmed evaluation performance
stays unconfirmed. Domain meaning stays with its domain owner.
No refinement turns failure, undecidability, non-performance or unknown effect
completion into greater standing. A new result over a different predicate does
not overwrite the earlier result.

Candidate availability, candidate fitness and authorised acceptance are three
predicates. `candidate_ready` can satisfy availability while fitness remains
falsified or unassessed. A lawful yield can satisfy the selected yielding
contract while product completion remains unresolved. A decision result binds
the predicate “disposition D on subject S at basis B was made under mandate M
by its bound authority”. A lawful rejection can satisfy that predicate while
candidate fitness remains undecided. Recording the decision is not its authority.
A not-applicable classification needs a supported applicability judgment; it is
never a synonym for a missing evaluation.

A stop reports the actual destination or task predicate through this record,
with its reason, observed effects and outstanding obligations. Its verdict
is indeterminate when the outcome remains undecided, falsified when admissible
evidence defeats that predicate, or the established scope/basis diagnosis.
Lawfulness of stopping is a separate decision predicate.

## Result conjunction

Conjunction evaluates whether all required predicates and their material joins
hold on the declared composite subject and basis. It retains the contributing
results, their authentication and predicate mapping, known failures and their
citations, uncovered required coverage, uncertain effects and invalidators.
The aggregate is another result in the same algebra, with those components
available through sufficient references. Its summary never replaces them.

The required set comes from the composite's applicability and coverage
contract, not from the list of returns received. F4's preservation obligation
therefore makes a missing required return visible even when every available
return is satisfied. F2/F6 also retain an authenticated counterexample when
another slot is missing. Frame conjunction and the library's Conjoin operation
apply this same distinction; their owners supply which predicates and joins
are required, not another rule for erasing failures or filling gaps.

The aggregate evaluation has performance performed when its combining rule is
applied; this does not change component performance. The composite declares its
effect boundary and the selected effect parts within it. First resolve a current
observation for each part, retaining the contributing observations, identities,
ordering and any supported supersession. A later timestamp alone is no
supersession argument. Conflicting or insufficient observations leave the part
unknown. Normalize every material possibly affected part, including one owned
by an absent evaluation slot, through the effect-observation rule in
[Result algebra](#result-algebra). That rule distinguishes a requested part
that did not start from an unrequested possible part observed not to begin.
The composite supplies no different classification for either case.

Sequential stages can affect the same part. Their local completion labels are
not inputs to the composite join until mapped onto that part's observed state
at the composite boundary. A completed deployment followed by its completed
rollback is reverted for the deployment effect; a subsequent completed
reapplication is completed there. The historical rollback remains evidence.
The declarations retain every material external part, including irreversible
ones; a local reversal cannot silently remove them from the scope.

Over the resulting disjoint part observations: any unknown gives unknown;
all not_requested gives not_requested; completed with only completed or
not_requested gives completed; not_started with only not_started or
not_requested gives not_started; reverted with only reverted, not_started or
not_requested gives reverted; every remaining fully observed mixture gives
partial. Retain each observation's part and contributing components. The combining
operation's own lack of mutation cannot label an effectful composite not_requested.

First authenticate each contribution against its producer, subject, basis and
required plan membership. An unauthenticated claim cannot discharge an
obligation. A missing planned judgment remains an absent slot with its known performance
fact or uncertainty; required coverage outside an authenticated plan remains
uncovered. These are separate
conditions. An invalid contribution does not erase an independently
authenticated finding.

For an interpretable composite predicate and governing basis:

1. Any authenticated, applicable falsification of a required predicate or material join makes
   the conjunction `falsified`. Missing or undecidable other coverage remains
   explicit alongside it.
2. With no such falsification, an invalid required basis prevents satisfaction
   and yields `invalid_basis`; a required out-of-frame judgment yields
   `out_of_frame` when no invalid basis applies.
3. Otherwise any unresolved applicability, missing evaluation, undecidable
   predicate or undecided material join yields `indeterminate`.
4. `satisfied` requires every applicable obligation and material join to be
   authentically satisfied, with coverage itself established. An empty list
   proves nothing unless the declared required set is established as empty.

The composite declaration distinguishes its admission conditions from the
material joins of the predicate being evaluated. Each relation has one of
those roles in that evaluation. A failed admission condition prevents an
interpretation; a false required join is counterevidence within an admitted
interpretation. The result names that declared role instead of reclassifying a
known failed join as a missing basis. If the composite subject or governing basis itself cannot be interpreted, the
aggregate is `invalid_basis`; independently valid component failures and their
scope remain exposed. This does not pronounce them false or forgotten.
Effect uncertainty prevents satisfaction where the predicate requires a known
effect state. An unrelated effect does not automatically invalidate a different
predicate; the dependency relation must justify its relevance.

A declared operator states its truth and falsity conditions over exact leaf
predicates and joins. On its fully decided admitted domain, those conditions
are disjoint and exhaustive, including failure of a required join. An
overlapping, incomplete or uninterpretable operator declaration is invalid_basis.
Unresolved well-formedness makes the operator result indeterminate and supplies
neither satisfaction nor falsification; independently valid leaf results remain
visible. Once well-formedness is established, its result can be satisfied only when authenticated
evidence establishes its truth condition and the material joins and coverage

## Workspace and context

The workspace is the continuing material state of the construction, including
its authoritative requirements, work products and durable records. Material
external state is observed through its owning interface. The actor's context is
a bounded account acquired from these sources. It is fallible and disposable.
Acquisition observes the subject and basis the activation actually binds,
including frozen snapshots where selected. Admissible contrary current evidence
reopens affected claims through their drift and re-entry rules; it does not
silently select a different basis. Current observations correct stale beliefs;
they do not grant permission to
change a requirement to match the implementation. What exists and what must
exist remain different questions on the same truth surface.

Acquisition binds the current task, subject, destination constraints, authority
and relevant observations. It includes known material dependencies directly or
through declared available inputs, and excludes irrelevant material unless
needed to establish irrelevance. A rule packet without its current subject is
insufficient. A digest without accessible meaning is insufficient. A summary
without supported freshness cannot override its owner. Absence from a partial
projection, sparse checkout or empty local record is not evidence of absence
in the bound subject; acquire its authoritative source or retain indeterminacy.

Context fit and adequate attention are different predicates. The execution
binding declares the material resource envelope and measurement boundary;
counted bytes or tokens establish fit only for the context actually covered by
that measurement. Actual use establishes whether the actor applies sufficient
relevant material to the selected task under those conditions. Fitting a
representation does not establish attention adequacy, and a successful task
does not measure unobserved context. No universal attention score follows.

An observation binds its source and observation time or version. Where the
subject may change between observation and effect, the binding supplies the
material freshness or concurrency condition: re-observe, compare a revision,
use a protected snapshot or return uncertainty. No universal isolation scheme
follows. The selected operation cannot assume a stale read is still current.

The cycle is acquisition from current state, a bounded authorised operation,
observation of its result, and acquisition for the next operation. Results use
[the result algebra](#result-algebra). The cycle can stop after any operation
without inventing completion. Private context can be discarded between cycles;
resumption reconstructs sufficient context from the continuing workspace and
authoritative inputs. It neither erases progress nor requires a transcript of
every earlier activation.

Reuse requires supported applicability: the same claim scope, adequate current
basis and evidence, valid dependencies and required independent authorship.
Changed support reopens the affected dependent claims. Unchanged independent

## Bounded construction

A describes current material state and what is justified about it. Z is the
selected set of constraints and acceptance conditions; many states may satisfy
it. Intent, Product and Specification refine Z under their owning authority.
Write material intermediate states as S0 → S1 → …, reserving Z for the
destination constraint set and naming a satisfying endpoint separately. A
transition binds its preconditions, permitted effects, result predicate and
outer obligations. Where finite context or attention prevents one adequate
activation, refine the task into supported transitions over those states.

Finite capacity motivates bounded acquisition. Purpose chooses the outcome;
identity identifies the work; compatibility and assurance determine which
transitions compose. These are additional premises, not consequences of a
resource bound. Decomposition preserves all material outer obligations and
the joins between parts. Local success establishes the outer outcome only
when the required coverage and preservation argument hold.

A total control contract supplies a response for every admitted control state,
including unavailable input, unknown world conditions, failed preconditions,
partial effects, exhausted capability and revoked or exhausted authority. Its
outcomes use the core result algebra. Its alternatives may include repair,
re-entry, refusal, yielding or termination under the actual grant. It does not
promise to solve every problem or make an external process terminate.
Deterministic, probabilistic and human operations retain their selected outcome
models; their enclosing control handles the observed result truthfully.

Progress is supported movement toward the selected destination. Useful discovery
can enlarge the known frontier; counts alone are no distance metric. Stopping
can be lawful without completion. Completion needs the required evidence and
acceptance conditions on the current candidate. Changing Z follows its owner
and cannot establish that the old destination was reached. Repeating a failed
relation needs a supported causal change; elapsed activity is no repair.

## Configuration

declares the material dependencies between their frames. It assigns effects

or a fixed inventory of roles. An adequate configuration can use one actor,
peers, a hierarchy or supported adaptive allocation.

Producing, checking and accepting remain different responsibilities even where
one actor is permitted to perform several. Required independent review retains

dependencies, outstanding obligations, observed and uncertain effects, admitted

## Contract application

A contract bounds an operation by its input and output domains, intended
predicate, governing constraints, material relations, evidence rule and actual
grants. Its binding names their owners and current basis. These are semantic
coordinates, not a required record format. An existing design, frame, function
or work carrier can supply them; this law requires no additional carrier or
validation stage.

The application predicate is: **this proposed operation or reliance is
admissible under this bound contract**. It differs from the predicate that the
operation achieves its intended outcome. Application uses the following
conditions once at the responsible consumer:

1. **Binding.** Identify the actual subject, intended predicate, governing
   interpretation, applicable policy and source/current-state coordinates.
   Names or equal bytes alone do not supply identity, standing or applicability.
2. **Support.** Account for the conditions and material dependencies capable
   of changing this determination. Inspect through an affected seam until its
   governing obligations are covered or evidence establishes independence of
   the far side. A task boundary, partial listing or absence of observed failure
   does not establish that independence. The domain selects its completeness
   and sufficiency criteria; the actor does not silently narrow them.
3. **Preservation.** Show that required input, output and cross-boundary
   relations hold under the declared compatibility or translation. Retain
   identity, meaning, lifecycle, producer/evidence coordinates, constraints,
   authority and effect distinctions where material. A difference may be
   lawful; it needs the instance's admitted relation. Neither universal field
   equality nor an invented translation decides compatibility.
4. **Authority.** Establish the actual operation or decision grant for the
   selected effect. Keep the owners of meaning, evidence, operation and
   disposition distinct. Shared code, a source reference or a satisfied
   judgment supplies no missing grant. Required independent assessment retains
   its owning conditions.
5. **Currentness.** Apply [workspace and context](FOUNDATIONS.md#workspace-and-context)
   to evidence reuse, observations, concurrency and uncertain effects. A
   supported changed dependency reopens the affected determination; an
   unsupported currentness claim stays unresolved. A previously satisfied
   check can be reused on supported unchanged premises; this law does not
   require rechecking fixed graphs or every unchanged relation on every event.
6. **Result.** Apply the [core result and conjunction law](FOUNDATIONS.md#result-algebra)
   on the actual predicates. Retain known failures, absent required coverage,
   scope/basis diagnoses, original domain outcomes, performance and effects.
   Unknown applicability is not non-applicability. A supported failure does
   not disappear because another required condition is undecided.

## Constitutional Chain

This family assumes F1 purpose, F2 interpretation, F4 preservation and F6
authority, together with a Product whose downstream work must realise declared
obligations. A downstream success then needs adequate upstream meaning and
traceable authority; [Contract application](TRANSFORMATION_LIBRARY.md#contract-application)
preserves those relations. This member chooses the chain, its change classes,
requirement categories, reconstruction and trace-closure rules. Goals and
Product owners select outcomes; Design selects any realisation allowed by the
constraints. The chain does not derive a unique implementation from F1–F6.

```
Goals → Intent → Product Definition → Requirements → Design → Realisation → Observations → Projection → Delta
                                                                                       ↓
                                                                                  Scenarios
                                                                                       ↓
                                                                                Gap Analysis
                                                                                       ↓
                                                                    Repricing / New Goals / Intent
```

- **Goals** define the current overriding concerns for the active body of work.
- **Intent** defines purpose and direction.
- **Product Definition** defines the current product realization of the mutable source project, its key terms, and end-state shape in terms that can be decomposed into requirements.
- **Requirements** define invariant truths the system must satisfy.
- **Design** defines the structural decisions, interfaces, carrier surfaces, and delivery topology that make those truths achievable.
- **ADRs** are one durable form of design record, not a second constitutional layer above design.
- **Realisation** carries those decisions in the tenant's concrete environment;
  code is the software case, and a performed human procedure is another case.
- **Observations** establish what occurred and what currently exists at their
  declared boundaries. Events are a durable carrier where selected.
- **Projection** presents the observations relevant to a declared question.
  It is checked against its source and current state; it is not another truth
  surface and does not require every consumer to replay a complete event stream.
- **Delta** reveals drift between intended truth and realized state.
- **Scenarios** test operational meaning — can the system actually do the thing the words describe?
- **Gap analysis** identifies where real use cases hit the current model and reveal insufficiency.
- **Repricing** updates goals, intent, product, requirements, design, or realisation when the system no longer harmonizes. When gap analysis reveals constitutional insufficiency, it generates new **Goals** and/or **Intent**.

This is the homeostatic loop. Every link in the chain is load-bearing. A break at any link — goals with no downstream repricing path, an unowned requirement, an ungrounded design record, realisation without a design decision — creates accidental law.

The workspace persists through this loop. At each activation, current material
state and valid authority define the new A; Z names the admitted acceptance
constraints. The actor acquires sufficient context for the next bounded
transition. Discarding that context does not rewind A. A new observation can
invalidate a belief or dependent result; it cannot silently change Z or create
permission. Revising Z follows the owning re-entry relation below.

`GOALS.md` is the bounded work-wave surface. It captures the current overriding concerns for the next body of work, keeps temporary focus out of deeper constitutional layers until it is intentionally repriced there, and is more immediate than intent while remaining higher-level than product definition and requirements.

`PRODUCT.md` is the bridge between direction and obligation. It states the current product-definition surface of the mutable source project in present-tense terms, names the product terms and boundaries that downstream layers rely on, and provides the surface that requirements decompose.

`PRODUCT.md` is not the immutable RC release artifact and not the installed product.

Those belong to the recursive product taxonomy above.

Requirements are the constitutional **what** of the project. They are not limited to user-visible product features. The live requirement surface may include capabilities, invariants, constraints, governance, and verification obligations. What matters is that each requirement states something the project must make true.

Design is the structural **how**. It chooses the concrete realization that satisfies requirement truth: interfaces, topology, file placement, carrier documents, entry/control surfaces, runtime wiring, and lawful tenant boundaries. Requirements may require such surfaces to exist and be delivered; design chooses where and how they are realized unless the path itself is constitutional.

For an STDO-defined product, the split remains exact regardless of physical
layout:

- the definition's `what` bindings locate the shared constitutional `WHAT`
- the definition's `how.build_tenants` bindings locate one or more independent
  `HOW` realizations of that shared `WHAT`
- tenant-local realization is derivative unless and until the governing truth is ratified in specification

## Change Management Rule

Every substantive change begins with intake triage, an explicit declared change
intent, and a lawful re-entry point into the constitutional chain.

### Universal Intake Triage

There is one front door for substantive change.

The intake label does not determine the process class.

That means a reported:

- bug
- feature request
- issue
- regression
- operator finding
- release blocker
- scenario failure

all enter through the same intake-triage process.

Intake triage must determine:

- whether the report represents a substantive change at all
- the affected product boundary and intended scope
- the lawful change class
- the lawful re-entry point into the constitutional chain
- the downstream surfaces and evidence that must be repriced, re-derived, or
  re-proved
- whether the work remains within the currently declared release scope or
  requires repricing of that release plan

No bug, feature, issue, or other intake may bypass this triage by going
straight to code, tests, or release handling.

The purpose of triage is not to create a separate tracking bureaucracy. It is
to classify impact correctly so the change enters the method at the right
constitutional boundary.

Triage triangulates a failure across applicable reference frames over the same
subject and basis. Each frame tests candidate diagnoses against its material
workspace variables, governing relations and evidence. Their combined results
constrain the supported cause, preserve unresolved alternatives and uncertainty,
and identify the smallest sufficient lawful scope of repair. The frame that
exposes a failure need not contain its cause. Repeating the same analysis under
different frame names supplies no additional causal evidence.

The intake judgment concerns which current relation fails or needs to change,
not whether the report's label is familiar. F1 and F2 bind that judgment to the
selected Product outcome and interpreted governing meaning; F3 binds its
observations to the current subject; F6 leaves any change to the relation's
owner. Thus a demonstrated implementation defect can support lower re-entry,
while a report that cannot distinguish implementation failure from missing
requirement meaning leaves that distinction unresolved. Neither finding grants
the mutation it suggests.

Intake applies [Contract application](TRANSFORMATION_LIBRARY.md#contract-application)
to that exact classification. Its binding selects the report, governing
sources, workspace and external observations, retained results and actual
assessment grant. Currentness decides which support can be reused; the
diagnosis itself is evaluated under the core result contract.
[Computed treatment](#computed-classification-and-treatment) owns the decision
whether the candidate or its governing relation needs correction. The single
intake route and named re-entry classes below are Spec's policy for carrying
that distinction, not additional results of the diagnosis.

Select the smallest sufficient applicable configuration under
[frame applicability and conjunction](REFERENCE_FRAME_METHOD.md#method-functions),
with [causal localization](#counterexample-localization)
where required. This selection prescribes neither a reviewer count nor another
review round; the bound independence and repair authority remain applicable.

The minimum lawful change classes are:

- `goal_reprice`: current bounded work-wave focus changes; re-enters at Goals and may flow through Intent, Product, Requirements, Design, Realisation, and Evidence where that focus changes deeper constitutional truth
- `intent_reprice`: directional or scope change; re-enters at Intent and flows through Product, Requirements, Design, Realisation, and Evidence
- `product_reprice`: current product realization changes while directional intent remains stable; re-enters at Product and flows through Requirements, Design, Realisation, and Evidence
- `requirement_reprice`: constitutional truth changes while project direction remains stable; re-enters at Requirements and flows through Design, Realisation, and Evidence
- `design_reframe`: realization structure changes while active intent and requirement truth remain stable; re-enters at Design and flows through Realisation and Evidence
- `realization_refactor`: local implementation, procedure, configuration, or attribute change with no intended constitutional or structural change; re-enters at the realized surface only and must prove no upstream drift

Smaller changes may re-enter below Goals only if they explicitly assert that no
upstream constitutional surface is changing.

The absence of a declared change class is process drift.

This triage family assumes F1–F4 and F6 on the exact requested change and its

# Writing Guide

This guide supports sufficient interpreted context under [Foundations](FOUNDATIONS.md) and the shared [transformation library](TRANSFORMATION_LIBRARY.md). Clear writing preserves the governing layer and material determinations; shortening prose alone establishes no semantic or operational improvement.

## Core Rule

Write as if the reader is technically fluent and short on time.

State the claim. State the reason. Remove the performance around it.

---

## Style Rules

1. Prefer direct positive statements over contrast framing.
2. Remove setup paragraphs that announce what the section will say.
3. Use concrete nouns and verbs instead of motivational or promotional language.
4. Keep one claim per sentence when possible.
5. Prefer precise technical vocabulary over vague intensifiers.
6. Use examples only when they reduce ambiguity.
7. Do not write filler transitions whose only purpose is tone.

---

## Remove These Habits

- “not X, but Y”
- “simply”
- “just”
- “clearly”
- “obviously”
- “powerful”
- “robust”
- “seamless”
- “game-changing”
- generic reassurance
- dramatic phrasing

These usually add tone without adding information.

---

## Good Prose

Good prose in this repo is:

- factual
- bounded
- explicit about authority
- explicit about uncertainty
- easy to challenge

If a sentence sounds polished but carries no new constraint or observation, cut it.

---

## Bad Prose

Bad prose in this repo:

- implies conclusions instead of grounding them
- repeats the same claim in different words
- mixes current reality with target intent without labeling the difference
- explains basic concepts to an expert audience
- turns straightforward instructions into brand language

---

## Method Alignment

Method documents should sound constitutional.

Requirements should sound normative.

Design should sound structural.

Commentary should sound analytical.

If the tone does not match the authority layer, rewrite it.

---

## Specification Artifact Practice

`SPEC_METHOD.md` is the constitutional authority for specification-layer roles and closure.

This guide handles the practical writing discipline for those artifacts.

When writing specification artifacts:

- state the current live truth, not a narrated transition
- keep each sentence in the right layer
- remove stale law instead of carrying it forward for comfort
- keep design detail out of constitutional layers unless the detail is itself constitutional

If a sentence sounds informative but does not change authority, constraint, or derivability, cut it.

---

## Practical Layer Checks

Apply [workspace-derived acquisition](FOUNDATIONS.md#workspace-and-context)
to the current owning surface before revising it. F1 supplies the writing
purpose; F2 and F4 require preserved interpretation and obligations; F5
motivates sufficient relevant context. The style choices in this guide are
its own conventions, not deductions from a byte limit. A writing review uses
the [core result](FOUNDATIONS.md#result-algebra) on the preservation or style
predicate actually checked; shorter text alone establishes neither.

When writing or revising a specification artifact, ask:

1. Can the next downstream layer derive from this?
2. Does this artifact state current truth rather than work in progress?
3. Does any sentence belong in a lower layer instead?

If any answer is wrong, rewrite or delete within the owning authority. A
predecessor determination retains its recorded
[UP-015 disposition](RELEASE_METHOD.md#successor-baseline-conservation-stdo-up-015)

## Standalone Successor Requirement

Source: this Product. The successor stands alone. Every `conserved` claim is stated in the successor's own text, so that the successor is complete and usable without the predecessor in force. A link to the predecessor shows where a claim came from, not that it is conserved. Under this requirement a link alone satisfies no disposition. This requirement is why construction comes in this order: the axioms first, then the whole predecessor restated on them.

Restated on the axioms. The successor is on its axioms when four relationships hold:

1. Foundation to law. A family of deciding contracts is a group of related rules that decide outcomes; a material family is one whose outcomes matter to the product. Each material family identifies three things:
   - the foundational premises it rests on;
   - the consequences that follow from them;
   - any additional domain or policy choices, with their owners.

   The whole set of material deciding rules is accounted for, including inherited rules. The candidate states its grouping and binds the covered rules, applicable pillar contributions and actual consumers to each argument. Independent review assesses that coverage; a document preamble or coarser grouping cannot hide an unsupported rule. Numbering and file boundaries do not prescribe the grouping. A demonstration over a few members is not presented as a derivation of every member.
2. Ownership and use. The Spec Method and the profiles use the shared contracts at the points where an actor actually enters and applies them, not only by cross-reference, without conflicting definitions or competing owners. An explanatory cross-reference alone does not establish this relationship.
3. Standalone conservation. Text the successor owns supplies every conserved determination needed for use.
4. Reduction. The pillars determine the shared laws and their specialisations under the [reduction requirement](#foundational-reduction-requirement). Repeated determinations are contracted into their shared owners, and material independent mechanisms that remain have a stated need.

Unchanged predecessor text satisfies these where it carries the relationships. Copied text does not establish the foundational relationship just by being present, and the share of text rewritten is not evidence that a relationship holds.

## Foundational Reduction Requirement

Source: this Product's [Foundational Reduction](../PRODUCT.md#foundational-reduction). The reconstruction must make the method simpler to determine and apply while preserving its necessary distinctions.

1. Account for each pillar's material contribution. Separate foundational premises, derived consequences, domain policies and implementation choices. A named calculus or a conceptual correspondence is insufficient without the deciding rules and consumers it governs.
2. Identify recurring determinations across the predecessor and the candidate. Establish one shared owner and replace their independent determination at each affected consumer with that law or an explicit refinement. Adding a common introduction while the consumers retain rival rules does not satisfy reduction.
3. Preserve required distinctions while consolidating machinery. Different domains may use the same transformation without acquiring equal identity, meaning, authority or evidence. A retained material primitive or independent policy identifies the distinction it supplies and why the shared contracts do not already decide it. This is stated in existing design and proof surfaces, not a new record for every helper.

   Conservation includes a rule's scope, modal force, triggers and exceptions. Moving a conditional or preferred policy into shared machinery cannot silently make it unconditional; replacing a domain rule with a reference cannot lose a required trigger or send responsibility back to the referring consumer. The shared contract supplies its determination, and the domain owner supplies the additional binding or policy it needs.
4. Reconstruct member boundaries from those responsibilities. Predecessor files, headings, procedural stages and actor arrangements impose no one-to-one successor partition. A conserved determination may move to a shared owner. Its consumers carry their necessary bindings; they do not reproduce the common law as a second authority. Intentionally removing a material obligation still requires its owning decision under the disposition requirement.
5. Demonstrate reduction on actual deciding paths. A deciding path is the rules, bindings and acquired information used from a declared entry to determine a permitted result or action for a task. Bind the exact predecessor and the preceding candidate named in that tenant's admitted execution contract before the reconstruction being assessed, with materially comparable tasks, inputs, authority and acquisition conditions. If no preceding candidate exists, record that fact; it does not waive the predecessor comparison. Cover each claimed recurring determination and its materially affected entry and consumer paths. Justified equivalent cases may share a comparison; the independent Reviewer checks the grouping and uncovered material paths. Acquisition includes the material actually obtained through the entry and its dependencies, with supplied context, repeated reads and measurement boundaries identified. Comparing file counts or loading a whole corpus does not establish ordinary acquisition cost.

   Reduction is established where a material recurring determination is supplied by one shared law used by its affected consumers, removing a previously independent determination, mechanism or necessary reconciliation. Identify the removed work and justify the material distinctions that remain. Preserve the required permissions, obligations, failures and uncertainty; changed meaning needs its accepted replacement relation. Declare the measured dimensions and any proposed tradeoff before the comparison, against the selected task and outcome, in the existing activation or qualification record. Disclose adverse changes against both comparison subjects. An unexplained increase in acquisition or necessary reconciliation prevents a satisfied conclusion that the affected path is simpler to determine and apply. A justified increase preserves a necessary distinction or binding, or follows an explicitly declared tradeoff whose adequacy the independent Reviewer assesses; a favourable change in another measure does not silently excuse it. A supported elimination witness remains supporting evidence when the required improvement is not established; it cannot make criterion 6 `satisfied` for that path. The judgment is `indeterminate` when evidence cannot decide the required improvement and `falsified` when a counterexample defeats it. Word count, a diagram, rewritten prose or a passing structural checker alone supplies no reduction witness, and no universal numerical reduction threshold is imposed.
6. Challenge the reconstruction with independently specified successful, refused and unresolved cases where applicable, including cross-domain composition, failure preservation and recovery. Disclose compared subjects, tasks, acquisition conditions, results and evidence limits. The expectations are fixed independently of the author before the trial. The Reviewer checks applicability and uncovered obligations rather than inferring complete coverage from selected examples.

The integrated candidate assessment covers its material shared owners and consumers across member boundaries. The construction supplies complete accounting; independent review evaluates its adequacy and the positive reduction evidence. Member assessment supplies the applicable arguments, local path comparisons and counterexamples for its cone; integrated assessment checks their composition, material coverage and overall conclusion. Unaccounted material rules, unjustified rival determinations, lost distinctions, unexplained adverse changes or missing required comparison evidence prevent a satisfied reduction conclusion. A smaller corpus is not required where retaining necessary meaning costs more; that cost remains visible in the comparison.

Both candidates bind the same ratified common input. Each keeps its own preceding-candidate comparison under the [reduction requirement](requirements/README.md#foundational-reduction-requirement); the head-to-head comparison uses shared tasks and acquisition conditions rather than treating unlike historical trials as matched evidence.

Before the comparison, a nonauthor specifies the tasks, supplied facts, grants, expected distinctions, ordinary entry routes, tools and resource envelopes; the common pen records them in one shared protocol in common territory, named by the common work carrier and pinned to the same immutable version by both candidates. Expected answers are withheld from task actors. Candidate-specific routing and implementation remain available within those conditions. Curated-frame use and ordinary discovery are reported separately; one cannot stand in for the other. Reuse of an earlier trial requires demonstrated applicability to the shared protocol and current candidate. Changed tasks, additional hints and different acquisition limits remain separate evidence.

Each return accounts for all six member criteria and the [construction and integrated-closure checks](conformance/README.md#construction-and-integrated-closure), distinguishing satisfied, falsified and unresolved obligations. Coverage of a local claim does not establish the whole candidate. Missing assessment withholds the dependent acceptance; it does not invent a failed evaluation of the text. Criterion 4 requires actual use under its declared conditions, including supported context fit. Neither a desk trace nor an unmeasured successful response completes that criterion.

Comparable coverage means the same obligations and material cases are assessed on both candidates under the same criteria, discriminators and, for actual use, the shared protocol; unmatched or unassessed scope is reported separately. Selection on conformance requires the six criteria and integrated obligations to be satisfied on the exact candidate. The owner compares remaining non-blocking findings only over comparable coverage, with their impact and any readability or maintainability tradeoff stated. If neither candidate qualifies, the return is no qualified choice; further construction or a changed selection boundary requires the owner's decision. Choosing a basis does not itself accept unresolved predecessor replacements, publish a release, merge a tenant branch or authorise adoption. Those acts retain their existing owners and conditions.

Acceptance criteria for one member restatement:

1. Every row of the member's frontier cone has exactly one UP-015 disposition. Each `conserved` or `superseded` row names all successor loci needed to recover the whole claim: its owning locus and any necessary domain or consumer bindings, each resolving to the required text.
2. For every `conserved` row, the Reviewer compares the source independently of the author and finds the claim's meaning present in the new release's own text. This is UP-015's semantic conservation, evidenced under the standalone successor requirement. A link to the source alone, a matching label, or a paraphrase that drops part of a rule fails.
3. Every `superseded` row names the successor relation accepted under [Construction Authority](#construction-authority), cites its ticket decision and names its carrying loci, showing what replaces that row's claim. Proposed replacements remain pending. Every `intentionally removed` row names the product owner's decision and reason. Every `not applicable` row gives a bounded reason, one that states the limits of what it covers.
4. Each selected task of the member has a frame that fits the declared limits, supplies sufficient relevant material and excludes irrelevant material. A fresh actor uses that frame, its subject and declared acquisition routes and tools correctly. Its work is judged against expectations specified independently of the author, without private validator knowledge or the author's memory. The evidence identifies the exact frame, subject, task, supplied instructions, acquired material and independent expectations. Reuse after a change requires evidence that the source, frame, task, actor conditions and material dependencies preserve the conclusion's applicability. Changed packets or tasks retain their own subjects. A corrected run is not an unchanged independent test of the correction. This establishes adequate context and attention for the tested conditions; byte fit alone does not.
5. The applicable [member-conformance discriminators](conformance/README.md#member-conformance) hold under source-first logical review. The affected a_c interpretation and acquired views preserve the owned determinations under the constraint-surface requirement. The review states coverage, independent expectations and unresolved obligations; structural validity alone establishes neither fidelity nor semantic conformance. Construction decisions and integrated closure are checked at their own boundaries.
6. The restatement meets the [reduction requirement](requirements/README.md#foundational-reduction-requirement) within its cone: shared laws govern the affected decisions, recurring independent determinations are contracted, and remaining material distinctions are justified. Applicable local deciding-path comparisons and counterexamples support that conclusion. The integrated assessment establishes cross-member coverage and the whole-candidate conclusion; its absence alone does not falsify a supported local claim. The restatement adds no new obligation without naming its purpose and material relation, and makes no needless change to work carriers or process. Prose size or structural validation alone does not satisfy this criterion.

Independence. The Reviewer does not assess its own authorship, including a material contribution to the subject or the repair under review. Reporting a defect, supplying a counterexample or identifying behavior already required by an owning rule does not itself author the repair; that Reviewer may recheck the defect. Authoring material wording, policy or design that is adopted in the repair is a contribution to the subject. Its author discloses that contribution and cannot supply independent acceptance evidence for it; another nonauthor covers the affected claim. Unaffected judgments retain their scope. Independently specified expectations do not come from the author of the behavior being assessed. Actor identity, model family, source contributions, supplied context and prior participation are disclosed where material to independence. A fresh context or another model name alone does not establish it. A different model family from the Writer is the default; a same-family nonauthor Reviewer is a declared exception, with its reason and limits in the activation record. The ported-contribution review assignment is specified in [Cross-Synthesis](#cross-synthesis).

Limits. Every activation declares its limits and measurement boundaries: context in bytes, wall time and spend. The context limit bounds the material concurrently retained in active actor context, including instructions, frame, subject and subsequently acquired material. Report supplied bytes, cumulative acquired bytes including repeated reads, and the measured or supported upper bound on active retained context separately. A 30 KB supplied frame plus 200 KB retained acquisition exceeds a 40 KB context limit; sequential acquisition fits only if each active context fits and the declared continuation preserves the material obligations. Fit can be established from recorded complete active inputs or a supported upper bound that includes any host-supplied context. No particular interface or host is required. Unmeasured platform context or unsupported truncation cannot establish fit: the fit judgment remains `indeterminate` unless other evidence establishes a counterexample, such as exceeding the limit. A correct task result retains its bounded standing without satisfying the missing fit judgment. Report wall time and spend after the activation. Attention is addressed through sufficient relevant frames and the actual-use evidence in criterion 4; it is not inferred from a byte or token count. This contract sets no universal budget. The Executive selects the limits for each activation; the Writer records them, identifying unknown or uninstrumented portions.

Closure. C3 closes for a tenant when every frontier row is disposed, every member is accepted under the grant, and independent assessment establishes the integrated candidate's reduction, complete required interpretation coverage and fidelity, and required frame-use evidence. The reduction conclusion covers material shared owners and their consumers across member boundaries under the reduction requirement. Member results contribute only their supported scope; they cannot establish the whole by omission. Reuse preserves its applicability, and changed dependencies reopen affected conclusions. Any required obligation whose assessment remains unresolved prevents closure. The product owner accepts the checkpoint.

### Condition-Based Closure And Reuse

A work claim is complete only when every applicable declared obligation is
satisfied by valid evidence for its exact subject, basis and scope, all required
judgments and owner rulings are present and applicable, and no active
non-closure condition remains. A mandatory but unknown applicability or
insufficient-evidence result withholds the dependent claim; evidence presence
alone is not satisfaction. The existing owner decides any reserved acceptance.

Review evaluates these conditions; its occurrence is not the closing event.
Where applicable law requires no independent review or reserved acceptance,
the authorized Writer may record the satisfied bounded result in the existing
carrier without adding a ticket, Executive appointment, review or design-view
recreation solely to mark completion. This does not waive a condition that
actually applies, including sprint-close or design-method law.

An unchanged obligation reuses valid applicable evidence and recorded J/O.
A material counterexample, changed evidence or basis invalidates the affected
claim and its dependent results before further reliance. An unrelated
observation is retained as bounded repricing input; it does not reopen a
satisfied claim or expand work automatically. Closure recording preserves the
exact evaluated scope, satisfied conditions, evidence and remaining residuals.

### Computed Classification And Treatment

Intake supplies one reusable classification result rather than requiring each
role to reconstruct the same facts. `C` denotes reproducible facts and declared
rule application; `J` denotes residual semantic or materiality judgment; `O`
denotes a ruling reserved to its actual owner. These annotations grant no
authority and introduce no calculus kind, runtime, classifier interface, or
mandatory document.

The explicitly selected source, worksite, or qualification capability produces
C over the exact request and desired outcome, known targets and effects,
operation grant and work lifetime, Product Definition and governing basis,
baseline and available candidate, declared relations, accepted design and
trace bindings, evidence, and applicable rules. Its output identifies the
producer and procedure revision, inputs, result, scope, source routes,
reproduction relation, unknowns and invalidators. Missing candidate or evidence
is an input state, not a claim that nothing changed.

The computed result must expose:

1. **Authority traversal.** Follow explicit source, ownership, dependency,
   composition and projection declarations from the affected targets and
   effects. Identify each reached layer and owner, its exact basis and
   changed/unchanged/unknown relation, the traversed edges, and the unresolved
   frontier. Include root, authority and grant changes even when Public bytes
   are equal. An absent edge does not prove irrelevance; undeclared or
   semantically uncertain materiality remains J.
2. **Public delta.** Enumerate the complete relevant serialized member universe
   under its owning declaration and applicable projection, including helper and
   generated dependencies. Report added and removed identities and every
   retained member with changed typed value or bytes, with exact before/after
   values. A rename is removal plus addition unless its owner supplies an
   identity-preserving relation. Missing candidate, incomplete enumeration,
   ambiguous identity or unavailable projection leaves the affected delta
   unknown; membership equality alone proves no value equality.
3. **Accepted-design coverage.** Join changed bytes and relations to explicit
   accepted scope, traces and acceptance evidence. Distinguish covered,
   missing, stale, ambiguous and outside-scope evidence. A filename, listed
   artifact or digest alone establishes no accepted coverage. Current trace
   coverage is a computed fact; residual semantic sufficiency remains J.
4. **Rule-determined treatment.** Apply only declared rules with sufficient
   input facts, recording their owners, matched predicates and consequences.
   Expose the smallest lawful re-entry, next action, applicable evidence or
   assessment, reserved ruling and carrier lifetime, with any conflict or
   missing premise still unresolved. A label or filename cannot select the
   route. When rules settle the question, invent no residual judgment.

A Public delta or other nonconformance does not itself require changing the
governing contract. If that contract remains sufficient for the authorized
outcome, reject or locally repair the candidate within its grant. Re-enter
the actual governing owner when the explicitly selected desired outcome
requires changed meaning or an applicable assessment establishes governing
insufficiency. C determines that consequence only from sufficient declared
premises; unresolved intended meaning or necessity is J and any reserved
decision remains O. Candidate behavior cannot author its own target law.

Unknown treatment withholds dependent reliance or promotion, not unrelated
authorized work. An existing bounded construction or evidence grant may permit
the cheapest useful discriminator, including obtaining the first candidate,
without asserting that the candidate is conformant. It carries its own exact subject,
territory, operations and stop conditions. Update the affected C result before
dependent effects or promotion rely on newly available evidence. Correct a
mistaken route at its smallest affected owner; preserve the original cause,
attempted subject, observed effect state and valid progress. Retry requires
the applicable outcome, authority and safe-recovery conditions; an unknown
effect state cannot be silently treated as no effect.

A new role, conversation or resumption reuses valid C after checking exact
applicability. Changed request, candidate, basis, owner/root relation,
projection, design trace/acceptance, rule, configuration or material evidence
invalidates its affected claims before reliance. Preserve predecessor and
successor identities, changed inputs, surviving facts and affected J
dependencies; recompute the wider frontier where independence is unproved.
`TICKET_METHOD.md` owns the existing carrier and recorded-J/O continuity rules.

## Consistency Gate Rule

No gate may close while the affected active surfaces are internally inconsistent.

For the declared change span, the framework must prove:

- the upstream surface remains sufficient for the downstream surface
- downstream artifacts do not contradict active upstream truth
- tests and qualification prove the active intended behavior rather than stale precedent

If that proof is missing, the change remains open even if one local artifact already looks correct.

Closure requires every applicable declared obligation satisfied by valid,
applicable evidence and every required judgment or ruling, with no active
non-closure condition. `TICKET_METHOD.md` owns work-state recording and reuse.
A review event, passing aggregate, completed artifact or status change cannot
substitute for that conjunction.

When a code/test mismatch appears during ticketed work, implementation behavior
is evidence but not authority. The mismatch is reconciled through the admitted
ticket, its intake triage, its lawful re-entry point, and the governing
requirement, design, module, graph, carrier, or closure surface. `TICKET_METHOD.md`
defines the ticket-local test-case authority rule.

### RF-012 Closed Results

Every evaluation returns a member of its declared result algebra. The baseline
result family is:

- `satisfied`: the declared predicate holds on the exact basis;
- `falsified`: a declared counterexample defeats it;
- `indeterminate`: available admissible evidence cannot decide it;
- `out_of_frame`: the evaluation requires an undeclared material relation or
  capability; or
- `invalid_basis`: the subject or basis cannot support the evaluation.

An externally owned compatible extension may refine this algebra while
preserving explicit indeterminate, out-of-frame, and invalid-basis pressure.

### Result Conjunction

A declared decision rule consumes closed frame results. The rule states:

- which results are mandatory;
- how conflict and indeterminacy are handled;
- which basis relations must agree;
- what decision authority owns the conjunction; and
- whether any result may veto or defer the decision.

Conjunction does not transfer the semantic authority of a contributing frame.

Every mandatory constraint must be satisfied with valid applicable evidence.
Common agreement cannot discard a constraint or material counterexample found
by only one contributor. Missing, wrong-subject, conflicted or indeterminate
mandatory results remain unresolved under the declared rule; aggregate green
status cannot replace them.

### Constitutional chain

```text
Goals → Intent → Product Definition → Requirements → Design → Code
  → Events → Projection → Delta → Scenarios → Gap analysis
  → Repricing, new Goals or Intent
```

Intent defines purpose and direction. Product Definition defines the current
product realisation of the mutable source project, its key terms and its
end-state shape in terms that can be decomposed into requirements.
Requirements define invariant truths the system must satisfy. Design
defines the structural decisions, interfaces, carrier surfaces and delivery
topology that make those truths achievable; ADRs are one durable form of
design record, not a second constitutional layer above design. Code
realises those decisions. Events record what happened. Projection
reconstructs current truth from the event stream. Delta reveals drift
between intended truth and realised state. Scenarios test operational
meaning: whether the system can do what the words describe. Gap analysis
identifies where real use cases hit the current model and reveal
insufficiency. Repricing updates goals, intent, product, requirements,
design or code when the system no longer harmonises; when gap analysis
reveals constitutional insufficiency, it generates new goals or intent (P2,
P1; rc.2 #constitutional-chain).

This is the homeostatic loop. Every link is load-bearing. A break at any
link, goals with no downstream repricing path, an unowned requirement, an
ungrounded design record, code without a design decision, creates
accidental law (P6).

### Upward Propagation Check

Triage consumes `SPEC_METHOD.md#computed-classification-and-treatment` for the
declared owner/layer traversal, complete relevant Public membership and value
delta, accepted-design scope and trace coverage, and rule-determined treatment.
The owning work carrier references that exact result and its residuals; a new
role does not repeat an unchanged walk.

For a bug, bind that treatment to the current requirement and accepted realizing
design's coverage of the affected behavior and sufficiency for the authorized
outcome. Apply the Spec owner's rule to the affected layer: actual requirement
insufficiency re-enters its owner; sufficient requirements with missing or
insufficient design re-enter Design; sufficient requirements and design with a
deviating implementation select repair or rejection under `realization_refactor`.
An actual upstream Goal, Intent or Product change follows its owner. The
classifier owns the distinction between missing evidence and established
insufficiency, and between candidate correction and changed governing meaning;
the ticket records that result and its J/O residuals instead of determining them
again from its label or Public delta.

### Condition-Based Closure And Reuse

Apply [Contract application](TRANSFORMATION_LIBRARY.md#contract-application) to
reliance on this work claim's closure evidence. Then evaluate `every applicable
declared obligation of this exact work claim is satisfied and no active
non-closure condition remains` through its Result condition and core conjunction.
The bound obligation set includes every required judgment and owner ruling on
its actual predicate: for example, `the authorised owner accepted this exact
subject`. A lawful different disposition cannot satisfy that acceptance
predicate. Retain the ruling's own decision result and the original closure
outcome; the existing owner still decides reserved acceptance.

Review evaluates these conditions; its occurrence is not the closing event.
Where applicable law requires no independent review or reserved acceptance,
the authorized Writer may record the satisfied bounded result in the existing
carrier without adding a ticket, Executive appointment, review or design-view
recreation solely to mark completion. This does not waive a condition that
actually applies, including sprint-close or design-method law.

Reuse applies Contract application's Currentness condition with
[Recorded Judgment And Owner-Ruling Continuity](#recorded-judgment-and-owner-ruling-continuity).
An unrelated observation remains bounded repricing input rather than reopening
the claim or expanding work. Record the exact evaluated scope, satisfied
conditions, evidence and residuals in the existing carrier.

### Consistency gate

No gate closes while the affected active surfaces are internally
inconsistent (P6, P4b; rc.2 #consistency-gate-rule). For the declared
change span the framework proves that the upstream surface remains
sufficient for the downstream surface, that downstream artifacts do not
contradict active upstream truth, and that tests and qualification prove
the active intended behaviour rather than stale precedent. If that proof is
missing the change remains open even if one local artifact already looks
correct.

The gate closes only under the closure condition that
[TICKETS §7 Condition-based closure and reuse](TICKETS.md#condition-based-closure-and-reuse)
owns, applied here with the obligations declared for the change span as
its required coverage. A material counterexample
to a mandatory constraint, a required judgment or ruling without a closed
result, or an obligation that no evidence addresses keeps the gate from
closing, and each stays recorded by kind (P5, P6). Reuse of the gate's
evidence and results is
[ACTIVATION §7](ACTIVATION.md#7-closed-result-and-reuse); TICKETS §7
records the work state on its carrier. A
review event, a passing aggregate, a completed artifact or a status change
cannot substitute for that conjunction (EVALUATION §5).

When a code and test mismatch appears during ticketed work, implementation
behaviour is evidence but not authority. The mismatch is reconciled through
the admitted ticket, its intake triage, its lawful re-entry point and the
governing requirement, design, module, carrier or closure surface.
[TICKETS §7](TICKETS.md#test-case-authority) defines the ticket-local
test-case authority rule (ASSURANCE §3 states the test authority rule).

## Consistency Gate Rule

No gate may close while the affected active surfaces are internally inconsistent.

Closure of a declared change span applies
[Contract application](TRANSFORMATION_LIBRARY.md#contract-application) to reliance
on its closure evidence, then evaluates the conjunction of all applicable
obligations and required judgments or rulings, with no active non-closure
condition. Its consistency predicates require:

- the upstream surface remains sufficient for the downstream surface
- downstream artifacts do not contradict active upstream truth
- tests and qualification prove the active intended behavior rather than stale precedent

A review event, passing aggregate, completed artifact or status change does not
discharge a missing required predicate in that conjunction.

The shared Result condition governs that conjunction; a local artifact's
fitness is a different predicate. `TICKET_METHOD.md` owns ticket-state recording
and the carrier binding for reuse; [workspace and context](FOUNDATIONS.md#workspace-and-context)
owns applicability of the resulting exact claim.
